title: Create Beat o Beet cold pressed beetroot juice website

requirements.text: Create a hero section featuring the Beat o Beet brand logo (circular design with beetroot illustration, '100% NATURAL VITALITY' text, and 'HEALTHY JUICE DRINK' tagline) as the centerpiece. Display the tagline '100% Natural Vitality' prominently and include a compelling headline about cold pressed beetroot juice.

quotes: logo as seen in the attached image

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays the Beat o Beet logo prominently
Natural vitality messaging is clearly visible
Section is visually engaging and sets the brand tone

requirements.text: Create a product showcase section displaying different beetroot juice variants in 180ml bottles. Each product card should show the bottle, variant name, key features, and benefits. Include at least 3-4 juice variants (e.g., Pure Beetroot, Beetroot-Apple, Beetroot-Ginger, Beetroot-Carrot).
acceptanceCriteria: Product grid displays multiple beetroot juice variants
Each variant shows 180ml bottle size specification
Product cards are visually consistent and informative

requirements.text: Create an 'About Our Process' section explaining the cold pressing method, health benefits of beetroot juice, and what makes the product 100% natural with no additives or preservatives.
acceptanceCriteria: Section clearly explains cold pressing benefits
Health benefits of beetroot are highlighted
Natural and preservative-free messaging is prominent

requirements.text: Create a 'Health Benefits' section highlighting nutritional advantages of beetroot juice including improved blood circulation, natural energy boost, antioxidants, and vitamin content.
acceptanceCriteria: Key health benefits are clearly listed with icons
Scientific/nutritional information is presented accessibly
Section reinforces the health positioning of the product

requirements.text: Create a 'Where to Buy' or contact section with a simple form for wholesale inquiries, retail locations, or order information.
acceptanceCriteria: Contact form accepts name, email, message fields
Backend stores inquiry submissions
Form provides confirmation feedback on submission

requirements.text: Implement a responsive navigation menu with links to Home, Products, Benefits, About, and Contact sections. Include the Beat o Beet logo in the navigation header.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation is sticky/fixed on scroll
Mobile responsive menu works on small screens
All navigation links scroll smoothly to sections

requirements.text: Apply a natural, earthy, and organic visual design theme inspired by the Beat o Beet logo's kraft paper aesthetic. Use warm earth tones (beige, tan, cream) as backgrounds, deep burgundy/beetroot red for primary actions and accents, and forest green for secondary elements. Typography should feel handcrafted and approachable with a mix of script/handwritten fonts for the brand name and clean sans-serif for body text. Create visual consistency across all sections with organic shapes, natural textures, and an overall wholesome, healthy food brand feel.
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette reflects the natural kraft and beetroot branding
Typography choices reinforce the organic, handcrafted brand identity
Overall design creates a cohesive, health-focused food brand experience

constraints: Logo design and branding from the uploaded image (1767680126294.jpg) must be preserved exactly
Product bottle size must be specified as 180ml throughout
Website must emphasize the cold pressed process and 100% natural positioning
